title: Delphi workspace config.toml
description: Validate config.toml parsed to JSON. Shape and enumerations only: `delphi doctor` is authoritative and also checks credentials, ratification and cross-references. Sections the code reads but that this schema leaves open (session, relay, away, optimistic, learning, hooks) are declared as plain objects. [[endpoints]], [access], [auth.*], [connectors.*], [harness.*] and [exec] are ratified: a change is a Red-tier proposal. API keys never appear here. The annotated template is crates/delphi/config.example.toml.

projects.description: Project repos the workspace operates on; `~/` is expanded.

untrusted_paths.description: Globs whose tracked files read as external_untrusted.

isolated.description: True: nothing is ever promoted out of this workspace.

models.description: `[models.<family>]` maps tier to model ID; `[models.catalog."<id>"]` holds per-model limits and prices.

registry.description: How the orchestrator learns of bundle agents (specs/041). flat: one line per agent, up to 20. auto: past 20, a domain index and the search_agent_registry tool.

assignment.description: How a dispatch picks its model (specs/056). static: the role's tier. discovered: capability class, measured results and quota.

evidence_enough.description: Measured results per (role, kind, model) after which a model is scored by them alone.

reserve.description: Role to the share of the mission budget no other role may spend.

nudge_edits.description: Writes to one file before the nudge; twice this ends the span.

tool_result_limit_kb.description: A tool result over this many KB is stored in the payload store and the history keeps a handle and a preview. 0 is off.

clear_after_kb.description: Old tool results are replaced by a handle in batches of about this many KB. 0 is off.

trim_arguments_kb.description: Old tool calls whose arguments reach this many KB keep a handle in place of their large text fields. 0 is off.

keep_recent_turns.description: Assistant turns, counted from the end, that clearing and trimming leave whole.

search.description: Web search engines for the archives pane's research mode (specs/028 section 10), tried in order, one at a time. Unset means the keyless parallel engine (specs/028 section 12); an empty list means research cannot run.

acquire.description: Library acquisition (specs/055 section 8): a daily job proposes public-domain and research sources in ONE digest batch. Off until enabled; it reaches out to the archives listed in context/sources/archives.toml.

byte_budget_mib.description: Bytes acquisition may hold; reaching it stops acquiring and evicts nothing.

max_item_mib.description: The largest text one acquired source may have.

token_share_percent.description: The scout's share of the install's tokens over the trailing week (specs/040 section 20.2). 0 keeps the job model-free.

interests.description: Topics you want, beside the workspace's project names.

validator.description: The fact validator (specs/040 section 15.1). The effective mode is the lower of this value and the daemon's latch.

mode.description: off: no fetch of any kind. advisory: the full fact path as a dry run that writes nothing validated. ratify: real writes, only after PROMOTE.

weak_sources.description: A claim supported only by Weak sources: label keeps it as unverified (weak), never as evidence; off refuses it (specs/040 section 27).

sources.description: The operator's additions to the default source list (specs/040 appendix A). Registrable domains.

pages.description: Generated search pages (specs/057 sections 5 and 6). A page is always labelled generated and not authoritative.

enabled.description: false: no page is written; searches still list the library's results.

external.description: ask: external search only when the operator asks (--external, or the console's key). off: never. on: every page also searches the web, unless --internal. Private sources never leave the install.

max_tokens.description: The longest page the writer may write, in tokens.

external_ttl.description: How long a page that used external search stays fresh: a number of days, or a duration such as 12h or 7d.

per_day.description: Pages the daemon builds in one day (a cache hit is free). Their validator tokens also count against the validator's share (specs/040 section 20).

min_ttl_days.description: The shortest cache lifetime, in days, the daemon accepts for a page the writer proposed one for (specs/061).

max_ttl_days.description: The longest cache lifetime, in days, the daemon accepts for a page the writer proposed one for (specs/061).

order.description: Family to endpoint IDs, in preference order.

harness.description: `[harness.claude]`, `[harness.agy]`, `[harness.codex]` and `[harness.copilot]` narrow the subscription-CLI defaults; scalar keys on `[harness]` itself (for example connector_settle_secs, subscription_budget_tokens) apply to all.

grades.description: Promote and nerf (specs/056 §4): a role's grade from -2 to 2, or a table of grades per task kind with `default` for the role itself. Ratified: an edit is a pending proposal until /ratify.

learning.description: The learning loop (specs/031 section 3.6). Each number is clamped to the core's floor and ceiling at boot. No key loads unratified content; an unknown key is a boot notice.

capture.description: Stage notes from denials, corrections, retries and escalations. Default true. Turning it off is allowed.

max_notes.description: Staged notes kept per mission; the oldest is dropped. Default 200.

triggers.description: Which capture triggers are on. Default all.

retro_min_tasks.description: Finished tasks before `delphi needs` says the coaching pass has material. Default 10.

hooks.description: `[[hooks.observe]]` and `[[hooks.deny]]` (specs/018): commands that can only watch or refuse.

credential.description: Where the key comes from, as for an endpoint.

cx.description: Google only: the Programmable Search engine id.

credential.description: A credential reference (for example `aws:work-sso`), or `none` for a loopback base_url. Never a secret.

client_secret.description: A reference such as `keychain:google-client-secret`, never the secret.

harnessProfile.description: Unknown keys are refused by the program.
